notes: Ga spellings and English meanings transcribed from the supplied lesson videos. Minor English grammar and punctuation normalized.
Cuts use the Ga utterances after English prompts; source background music may remain.
These are attributed lesson excerpts, not independently speaker-certified recordings.
The greetings lesson contains additional conversational responses whose meaning or standalone audio boundaries were not clear enough to release.
For the toilet expressions, the polite form is used. Intro previews, recaps, lesson commentary and the daily-routine pop quiz are omitted.

sources.file: Body Parts (Part 1)_ GA Learning with Little Languages_(360P).mp4
Say how you feel _ Learn Ga(360P).mp4

phrases.translation: No, I do not speak Ga

phrases.word: Ofainɛ, tsɔ̃ɔ̃mɔ̃ mi bɔni awieɔ Ga
phrases.translation: Please teach me how to speak Ga

phrases.word: Obaanyɛ ni otsɔ̃ɔ̃ mi Ga wiemɔ̃?
Daabi, ŋyɛ̃ŋ mã tsɔ̃ɔ̃ bo Ga
phrases.translation: No, I can't teach you Ga

phrases.word: Hɛ̃ɛ̃, matsɔ̃ɔ̃ bo bɔni awieɔ Ga
phrases.translation: Yes, I will teach you how to speak Ga

phrases.word: Yɛ Nyɔ̃ŋmɔ dromɔ nãa ŋyɛ jogbaŋŋ

phrases.translation: Which tribe do you belong to?

phrases.word: Ŋye afii nyɔ̃ŋmãi enyɔ̃ kɛ ekpaa
Ŋye afii nyɔ̃ŋmãi ekpaa kɛ nɛ̃ɛ̃hu
Ŋfeɔ Youtube videos, ni Nikaselɔ hu jimi
phrases.translation: I create YouTube videos, and I am also a student

phrases.word: Ŋyɛ hejɔɔmɔ mli shi ŋfeɔ Youtube videos
phrases.translation: I am retired, but I create YouTube videos
What do you do for fun?

phrases.word: Ŋboɔ radio toi ni ŋkwɛɔ TV
phrases.translation: I listen to the radio and watch TV
No, I don't go on Facebook
But I like looking at pictures
Do you keep some animals at home?

phrases.word: Ŋyɛ gbee kome kɛ alɔntei ejwɛ
phrases.translation: I have one dog and four cats
I have some chickens at home
This Christmas I'm throwing a party
What would you like me to do?
Shall I bring some of my chickens?
No, the food will be too much
Please give me your phone number
I wake up at 5:00 am every day
Firstly, I go to the toilet
I wipe myself with a towel

phrases.word: Ŋkwɛɔ aiŋshwɛ/ashwishwɛ mli kɛ shɛɔ ŋtsɛ̃ŋ
phrases.translation: I look into the mirror to shave my beard
I apply lotion to my body

phrases.word: Kɛkɛɛ, ŋtee kpataashi ŋyahoo leebi niyenii
phrases.translation: Then, I go to the kitchen to prepare breakfast

phrases.word: Ŋhoɔ akasã ni ŋkɛ blodo kɛ butru nuɔ̃
phrases.translation: I cook porridge and eat it with bread and butter

phrases.word: No sɛɛ, ŋshiɔ̃ shiã leebi ŋmɛjii ekpaa
phrases.translation: After that, I leave the house at 6:00 am

phrases.word: Ŋmɛ̃ɔ trɔtrɔ ni kɛmi yaa nikasemɔ̃he ɛ
phrases.translation: I wait for a trotro which takes me to school

phrases.word: Kɛ mii ya nikasemɔ̃he ɛ, ŋkwɛɔ adafii ni atswaa yɛ ŋfone ɛ nɔ̃
phrases.translation: On my way to school, I watch the news on my phone

phrases.word: Leebi titri ji mi nikasemɔ̃ bei
phrases.translation: Most of my classes are in the morning

phrases.word: Kɛ ŋkpa nikasemɔ̃ɔ̃ ŋyeɔ bei ni eshwɛ ɛ, yɛ wolotoohe we ɛ
phrases.translation: After class, I spend the day in the library
In the afternoon, I buy food

phrases.word: Ŋtsakɛɔ ŋniyeniŋ ɛ̃ mli kɛ fufui kɛ wonu aloo amãdãŋ tsuru kɛ yɔɔ aloo jɔlɔf
phrases.translation: I alternate between fufu and soup, plantain and beans, and jollof

phrases.word: Ŋshiɔ̃ nikasemɔ̃ we ɛ gbɛkɛ ŋmɛjii ejwɛ
Daa Hɔɔ ɔ, ŋkudɔɔ ŋtsɔ̃ne kɛyaa nitsumɔ̃
phrases.translation: On Saturdays, I drive to work

phrases.word: Ŋboɔ radio toi yɛ tsɔ̃ne ɛ mli
phrases.translation: In the car, I listen to the radio

phrases.word: Kɛ ŋshɛ nitsimɔ he ɛ pɛ, kɛkɛ ŋsu ŋlaptop ɛ
phrases.translation: Once in the office, I turn on my laptop

phrases.word: Ŋkwɛɔ wodzi ni a ŋmãŋmai ɛ̃ ni ŋhãã amɛ hetoi
phrases.translation: I check my inbox and respond to emails

phrases.word: Dãni mãye shwãne niyenii ɛ̃, ŋsaa ŋvideos ɛ ŋtɔɔ
phrases.translation: Before my lunch, I prepare my videos

phrases.word: Ŋkɔɔ shwãne hejɔɔmɔ̃ bee koni ŋkɛ mãini ŋkɛ tsuɔ̃nii ɛ̃ aya yenii
phrases.translation: I take a lunch break and eat with my colleagues

phrases.word: Kɛ ŋkpa, ŋshɛɔ shi gbɛkɛ ŋmɛjii ekpaa
phrases.translation: When I finish work, I get home at 6 pm

phrases.word: Ŋyafɔɔ ŋde, kɛ ŋshɛ shiã nɔ̃ŋŋ pɛ
phrases.translation: I wash my hands as soon as I arrive home

phrases.word: Mi diɛŋtsɛ, ŋfeɔ ŋshiã nitsumɔ̃i ɛ̃
Ŋnãã hoɔ niyenii ɛ̃ ni miŋmɛ̃ɔ okplɔ̃ɔ̃
phrases.translation: My grandma cooks and I lay the table

phrases.word: Wɔ kwɛɔ TV yɛ asaaanɔ̃, kɛ etɔko wɔ
phrases.translation: We watch TV in the living room if we're not tired

phrases.word: Beikomɛ̃i ɛ̃, ŋsumɔ̃ɔ̃ mãkãne nii dãni mãwɔ
phrases.translation: Sometimes, I like to read before sleeping

phrases.word: Ŋkwɛɔ Youtube yɛ ŋfon ɛ̃ nɔ̃ kɛ ŋkã saa nɔ̃
phrases.translation: I watch YouTube on my phone when I'm on the bed
